notes: Same site-visit as Bestsellers/Clearance (see those notes for access route detail). Scoped to Home department (shop.mango.com/es/es/h/home). Found one genuine New Arrivals PLP in the Home landing page's hero-banner set: 'NEW NOW' (H1), promotion_name 'home-casa-herobanner-NEW-NOW-HOME', catalogId nuevo_home. 'New Now' is Mango's own term for its newest-arrivals listing (equivalent to 'Novedades'/'New This Season'); opened and confirmed it is a genuine PLP (real product grid, filters, pagination) representing recently-added Home products, not an editorial/lookbook page. pagination.totalItems=469. No sub-structure exists - single undifferentiated listing for the whole Home department. Also checked the site's generic sitemap page and UI strings: 'novedades' appears only in unrelated marketing-copy strings (newsletter signup, empty-cart CTA, 404 page), not as a distinct nav link, confirming New Now is the sole New-Arrivals-type concept. Checked mangooutlet.com's separate Home outlet section too - it has no distinct new-arrivals node (only Dormitorio/Salon/Comedor y cocina/Bano/Ver toda la coleccion/Descuentos especiales), so nothing to add there for New Arrivals.
